datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected acutely food insecure population estimates on a monthly schedule throughout 2019 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, generating scenario-based estimates of populations facing acute food insecurity as a proxy impact of underlying hazards (primarily drought and conflict-related disruptions).

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET) conducts regular enumerator-based assessments of acutely food insecure populations across multiple scenarios to monitor food security crises.
